description: This file defines theme-related functions for a frontend project, including a base theme object and functions to generate color palettes and category color mappings.

methods.name: getOceanTheme
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette
methods.description: Generates a deterministic color palette seeded by Ocean theme colors, suitable for categorical series with up to N categories.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap
methods.description: Maps category names to colors using the categorical palette, maintaining stable order.
